customPatterns.title: Custom log formats and highlighting
customPatterns.description: Use Ideolog: Formats and Highlighting for validated forms and sample capture previews, or paste <LogParsingPattern …/> and <LogHighlightingPattern …/> elements from an Ideolog settings export or the Ideolog custom log formats wiki (github.com/JetBrains/ideolog/wiki/Custom-Log-Formats). Colours map to the nearest theme colour; HIDE patterns are ignored. An open log picks up changes when it is edited or reopened.

consoleHighlighting.title: Highlight errors, warnings and exceptions in Run consoles
consoleHighlighting.description: Colours the words ERROR, FATAL, SEVERE, CRITICAL, WARN and WARNING and the first line of Java and Python exceptions in the output of every Run and Debug console. Whole lines keep the IDE's own level colours.

timeGapSeconds.title: Mark time gaps (seconds)
timeGapSeconds.description: Colours the time of an event that comes at least this many seconds after the previous one. 0 turns it off. Needs a format whose time column reads as ISO-like, Logcat, syslog or HH:MM:SS.
